title: The model stream stalls past its deadline
description: The model stream stops producing tokens before completion and exceeds its deadline; the harness must cancel it, keep the turn fenced and use the fallback route.
callerVisible: The caller hears an approved holding line and then a fallback or a person.
backendEvidence: Deadline exceeded on the model invocation
Stream cancelled; no late tokens released
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:MODEL_HANG] owned by WP-15 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the model stream stalls past its deadline

postconditions: The stalled stream is cancelled at its deadline
No late output is released after cancellation
The fallback route keeps the caller connected
